title: Q4 calendar build — Prime Fall deadline Aug 21
narrative: Deal submissions run first — the Prime window closes in two days and a missed deadline is a lost quarter of Amazon share. Everything else is scheduled, not live.

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

execution.arming: Available from the Approve dial upward. At Suggest, every in-flight adjustment waits for you — including the media top-up.

plan.name: Marketplace deal submissions
plan.meta: 2 submissions as deadline tasks · Prime Fall closes in 2 days

items.name: Prime Fall submission
items.detail: 22 SKUs at 20% off the 30-day median with 500 units committed each. Three SKUs flagged short of the commitment — the inbound pull-forward is on Planner.

items.name: Walmart Deal Days submission
items.detail: 18 SKUs at 15% with a clean 30-day price history verified. No pre-event price movement on any SKU in the set.

items.name: Price-history audit
items.detail: Both platforms audit the 30-day median. Realify checks it before submission so a rejection does not cost us the window.

plan.name: Promo configs and codes
plan.meta: 6 events across 4 channel platforms · codes generated, not published

items.name: Channel promo configs
items.detail: Depth, SKU list, window and channel written into each platform. Scheduled — nothing goes live before its start date.

items.name: Discount codes
items.detail: Unique codes per event and per segment for the DTC events, single-use for the email and SMS sends, with caps matching the reserved units.

items.name: Amazon coupon suppression
items.detail: The 6 stacking coupons are suppressed for the BFCM window so effective depth stays at the deal price rather than reaching 34%.

plan.name: Inventory reservations
plan.meta: unit reservations per event · 3 SKUs need an inbound pull-forward

items.name: Prime Fall unit commitment
items.detail: 11,000 units reserved and held out of other channels for the window. Three SKUs are 40–120 units short and need the inbound 11 days early.

items.name: BFCM cover check
items.detail: Cover verified across 48 SKUs at the projected sell-through, with a 12% buffer for the upside case rather than the plan case.

items.name: Clearance cohort lock
items.detail: Four aged cohorts fenced so nothing in them is sold at full price in the four weeks before the clearance window.

items.name: Bidder media plan
items.detail: $8K on the Prime window and $32K on BFCM, both flighted to the event dates with the bid floors raised for the duration.

items.name: Email and SMS calendar
items.detail: 13 emails and 1 SMS across the three DTC events, with segments and suppression rules already set on the lifecycle side.

items.name: Creative deadlines
items.detail: Asset due dates set back from each event start, so a missing hero image is a task with a date rather than a surprise on launch morning.

plan.name: Pacing and readouts
plan.meta: live pacing per event · +14-day incrementality readouts booked

items.name: Live pacing tiles
items.detail: Units, revenue, CM%, promo spend and inventory burn against plan, refreshed every 15 minutes while an event is running.

items.name: Incrementality readouts
items.detail: One per event at +14 days, measured against the matched baseline with the trough netted out, then written into the history library.

items.name: Early-exit rules armed
items.detail: Three stop conditions per event, agreed at approval. A live event can be halted on them without reopening the argument.
